about: How the talk library chooses (Docs/Design/62-talk.md, section 2). Of the rules and scenes that hold, scores (the criteria tested, plus priority) are grouped into tiers, best first; a tier is chosen by these chances, then one within it. With two tiers the best takes the lower share too (80/20). A priority of strict_priority or more always wins when it holds; below 0 speaks only when nothing else holds. named_person is what self.id=... counts for in a score. repeat: concepts whose lines may be said again to those who've heard them. alone: concepts with one speaker. best_only: concepts that always take their best tier (a resident answering a player). concepts: every concept a rule may answer.
